Your guild might instead be a loose network linking artisans scattered among the towns and villages of a larger realm. Work with your DM to decide what sort of guild you belong to. You can choose your guild's business from the table or determine it randomly with a die roll.

公会成员 Guild Membership
你身为公会中一名备受尊敬的正式成员，可以享受到公会所提供的一些好处。公会中的同僚会在你需要时为你提供食宿，甚至在必要时为你安排身后事。公会在某些市镇设置有会馆，你可以以此作为与同行交流的场所，也可以从中开发潜在的客户、合作伙伴或雇工。
公会常常掌握着庞大的政治资源。当你被指控某项罪名时，公会可以为你提供全面的支持，前提是你必须为自己的清白做出举证，或是你的罪名必须仍可接受辩护。倘若你身处公会高层，甚至可以藉由公会获取有力的政治地位。而这些人脉资源都需要你为公会捐赠金钱或魔法物品来维持。
你每个月必须上交5 gp作为会费。若你因故未缴这笔费用，则必须在补齐后才能重获公会的青睐。
target:
Guild Membership
As a respected, full member of your guild, you enjoy certain benefits it provides. Your fellow guild members offer you food and lodging when you need them, and can even arrange your funeral if necessary. In some towns and cities, the guild maintains halls where you can meet others in your trade and find prospective customers, business partners, or employees.
Guilds often command considerable political resources. If you are accused of a crime, your guild can offer its full support, provided that you present evidence of your innocence or that the charge against you can still be defended. If you hold a senior position in the guild, you might even gain considerable political standing through it. Maintaining these connections requires donations of money or magic items to the guild.
You must pay 5 gp in guild dues each month. If you fail to pay for any reason, you must make up the missed payments before you regain the guild's favor.

target:
Unlike an artisans' guild, your guild consists mainly of merchants, caravan owners, or shopkeepers. You do not make goods yourself; you earn your living buying and selling other people's work, or trading in the raw materials manufacturers need. Your guild might be a large merchant consortium or family whose influence extends over a considerable area. You might transport goods between regions by ship, wagon, or caravan, or buy directly from traveling merchants to stock your own small shop. Sometimes a traveling merchant's way of life can carry them further into adventure than an artisan's.
You can replace your proficiency with artisan's tools with proficiency with navigator's tools or knowledge of one additional foreign language. You can also replace the artisan's tools in your starting equipment with a mule or a two-wheeled cart.

Retainers. You gain three servants loyal to your family. These retainers can act as attendants or messengers, and one of them can be a steward. They are commoners who can handle everyday tasks for you, but they cannot fight on your behalf or follow you into obviously dangerous places, such as dungeons. If you habitually abuse or threaten them, they will leave you.
One of these retainers is replaced by a squire who serves you; assisting you is part of their training to become a knight. Your other two retainers might include a groom who tends your horse and a servant who cares for your armor and can also help you put it on. As a symbol of chivalry and an expression of courtly love, you might attach a banner to your equipment representing a noble to whom you have sworn allegiance, an expression of pure devotion. The person to whom you are devoted can serve as your bond.

At the start of your adventuring career, you have enough money to live safely at a modest lifestyle for a dozen or so days. How did you obtain it? What gave you the strength to break out of your desperate circumstances and seek a better life?

target:
Variant: Investigator
Rarer than guards or patrol officers are an organization's investigators, who specialize in uncovering the truth after a crime. Although they are seldom found in rural areas, almost every case of appreciable size has one or two investigators skilled in examining crime scenes and tracking down criminals. If you were an investigator, you can replace the background's proficiency in Athletics with proficiency in Investigation.

Use the soldier's characteristics tables in the Player's Handbook as the basis for your characteristics and motivations, adapting entries where appropriate to fit your identity as a city watch member.
Your bond might involve your fellow watch members or the watch organization itself, and will almost certainly be connected to your community. Your ideal might include promoting peace and security. An investigator might instead have an ideal concerned with achieving justice by solving crimes.

剑湾中的组织
Factions of the Sword Coast
由于在北地缺乏大型集中政权的政府，在剑湾这片土地上分布着许许多多和剑湾政治阴谋有着密切关联的隐秘组织。如果你的背景是一名北地主要组织的代理人的话，以下介绍可能对你有所帮助。

竖琴手联盟The Harper。 自成立多年以来，竖琴手联盟经历了多次的解散和重组，如今他们仍旧是一个有着强大实力的幕后组织，他们喜欢更多的通过公理和知识来阻止邪恶的行为，而不是运用暴力。竖琴手表通常熟练于调查（Investigation），这让他们能够熟练的进行窃听，间谍活动。他们通常会向其他竖琴手，共同理念的吟游诗人，旅店老板，游侠和与竖琴手联盟相同理念的神的神职人员寻求援助。

铁手套教团The Order of the Gauntlet。 作为费伦大陆上一个新起的力量，铁手套教团有着和竖琴手联盟相似的理念。然而他们的方式截然不同：铁手套的教义是作为神圣的战士在寻求真理的道路上摧毁邪恶，倡导公正，他们从来不会将自己隐藏在阴影之下。教团成员们熟练于 宗教（ Religion），且通常会向与他们理念相同的执法部门，或是教员们信仰的神的神职人员们寻求援助。

翠绿闲庭 the Emerald Enclave。 保持自然秩序的平衡和对抗破坏这种平衡的力量，这是翠绿闲庭的两个目标。这个组织中的人员通常是野外生存大师，并且以这片土地为生。他们通常熟练于自然（Nature）技能，当他们遇到困难时，会从树人，猎人，游侠，野蛮人部落，德鲁伊集舍和信奉自然之神的神职人员那里寻求帮助。

领主联盟 The Lords` Alliance。 在某种程度上说，领主联盟的代理人们就代表了所在的城市，还有构成联盟的国家和政府。但是作为一个关切集体利益的联合组织，它跨越在本地政治和地理领土之上，领主联盟通过工作在各个联盟城市内的工作人员的日常工作，架设起了自己独有的组织结构。一个联盟代理人需要对历史（History）知识有深厚的了解，在他们遇到困难时，会向所属联盟的政府，还有其他支持联盟理念的领导人和组织寻求帮助。

散塔林会 The Zhentarim。 近年来，散塔林会通过改善它们在普通人中的名声，成为世界上最显眼的一个组织。这个组织吸收来自各行各业的工作人员和合作者，让他们以达成以暗黑情报网目标为任务进行工作，但在本质上并不需要进行犯罪。暗黑情报网人员通常秘密的进行工作，并且非常熟练于 欺诈（ Deception）。他们会从法师，雇佣兵，商人和与散塔林会结盟的神职人员那寻求帮助。
target:
Factions of the Sword Coast
Because the North lacks a large, centralized government, many secret organizations are scattered across the Sword Coast, closely involved in its political intrigues. If your background makes you an agent of one of the North's major organizations, the descriptions below might be useful.

The Harpers. Over the many years since their founding, the Harpers have disbanded and reformed several times. Today they remain a powerful organization working behind the scenes, preferring to prevent evil through justice and knowledge rather than violence. Harper agents are usually proficient in Investigation, which helps them eavesdrop and conduct espionage. They commonly seek assistance from other Harpers, like-minded bards, innkeepers, rangers, and clergy of gods whose principles align with those of the Harpers.

The Order of the Gauntlet. A rising power in Faerun, the Order of the Gauntlet holds ideals similar to those of the Harpers, but its methods are very different. Its doctrine calls on its members to act as holy warriors, destroying evil and championing justice in their search for truth. They never hide themselves in the shadows. Members are proficient in Religion and commonly seek help from law enforcement organizations that share their ideals, or from clergy of the gods the order's members worship.

The Emerald Enclave. Maintaining the balance of the natural order and opposing forces that disrupt that balance are the Emerald Enclave's two goals. Its members are usually masters of wilderness survival who live off the land. They are commonly proficient in Nature. When they face difficulties, they seek help from treants, hunters, rangers, barbarian tribes, druid circles, and clergy who worship nature gods.

The Lords' Alliance. To some extent, agents of the Lords' Alliance represent their own cities and the states and governments that make up the alliance. Yet as an association concerned with collective interests, it reaches beyond local politics and territorial boundaries. Through the everyday work of personnel stationed in its member cities, the Lords' Alliance has established its own distinctive organizational structure. An alliance agent needs a thorough knowledge of History. When in difficulty, agents seek help from governments belonging to the alliance, as well as other leaders and organizations that support its ideals.

The Zhentarim. In recent years, the Zhentarim has improved its reputation among ordinary people and become one of the world's most prominent organizations. It recruits workers and partners from every walk of life to pursue the Black Network's objectives, though such work does not inherently require criminal activity. Black Network personnel usually operate in secret and are highly proficient in Deception. They seek assistance from wizards, mercenaries, merchants, and clergy allied with the Zhentarim.
